name: Quebrada Blanca copper mine area, Tarapacá, Chile
default_claim: The mining operation at this site stopped expanding after 2019.
description: High-altitude open-pit copper operation in the Atacama. Pre-scouted with real Sentinel-2 L2A scenes (Nov 2019 vs Nov 2023, both cloud-free over the AOI); candidate surface disturbances appear around waste dumps, pit walls and a new linear feature.
location_source: Mine location per Wikipedia 'Quebrada Blanca' (−21.0043, −68.8010); AOI centre is ~2 km north, inside the 6 km AOI.

name: Bingham Canyon open-pit mine, Utah, USA
default_claim: The Bingham Canyon pit has not expanded since 2019.
description: Large, long-established open pit. Summer 2019 vs summer 2024; real scenes show localised changes inside the existing pit and on its walls.
location_source: Mine location per Wikipedia 'Bingham Canyon Mine' (40.523, −112.151).

name: Southwestern Amazon frontier site, Brazil (−9.54, −65.93)
default_claim: No forest was cleared in this area after 2020.
description: Located by a 20 km wide scan of real dry-season imagery (Jul 2020 vs Jul 2023) for forest-like canopy loss. Mix of forest, pasture and newly bare ground.
location_source: Coordinates chosen from imagery (no named site claimed).

name: Southern Amazonas forest control site, Brazil (−8.25, −66.95)
default_claim: This forest area has remained intact since 2020.
description: Continuous canopy in the pre-scout (Jul 2020 vs Jul 2024): no candidate loss regions were found. Included as a control where a no-clearing claim can be tested.
location_source: Coordinates chosen from imagery (no named site claimed).

name: Tesla Gigafactory Texas site, Austin, USA
default_claim: No large construction took place on this site after 2020.
description: Fields and scrub east of Austin in May 2020; by June 2023 the factory roof and paved lots show as new built-like surface (red), with graded ground around it shown separately (amber).

name: Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg site, Grünheide, Germany
default_claim: The factory on this site was completed by 2023.
description: Pine forest in July 2019; by July 2023 the halls and paving show as new built-like surface, and a large cleared sand area to the north as earthworks. The app can show new built surface, not that a factory is 'completed'.

name: Löcknitztal nature reserve, Brandenburg, Germany (control)
default_claim: No construction took place in this protected area after 2019.
description: Protected river valley about 7.5 km from Giga Berlin. Pre-scout found no new built surface or earthworks between July 2019 and July 2023.

name: Lake Mead, Las Vegas Bay, Nevada, USA
default_claim: Lake Mead's shoreline at Las Vegas Bay has not receded since 2019.
description: Bay head and coves of Lake Mead, July 2019 vs August 2021 (Lake Mead reached a record low in 2021). Sentinel-2 C1 L2A has almost no 2022 scenes here, so 2021 is used.
location_source: AOI placed from imagery ~5 km ESE of the Las Vegas Wash point on Wikipedia 'Las Vegas Wash' (36.132, −114.879), at the bay head.

name: Caldor Fire area, Grizzly Flats, California, USA
default_claim: No fire burned around Grizzly Flats in summer 2021.
description: Forest around Grizzly Flats before and after the August 2021 Caldor Fire. Same-year comparison, so the dates are flagged as seasonally different.
location_source: Wikipedia 'Grizzly Flats, California' (38.6364, −120.5275); the page describes the Caldor Fire destroying ~500 buildings there on 17 Aug 2021.
